# 第41题

**分值**: 2分

## 题目内容

41. Which of the following would be the best title for the passage?
A. Where the Problem of Robocalls Is Rooted
B. Who Is to Blame for the Problem of Roboealls
C. Why Robocalls Are About to Get More Dangerous
D. How Robocalls Are Affecting the World of Technology

## 选项

A. A. Where the Problem of Robocalls Is Rooted

B. B. Who Is to Blame for the Problem of Roboealls

C. C. Why Robocalls Are About to Get More Dangerous

D. D. How Robocalls Are Affecting the World of Technology

---

## 参考答案

C
